messages.subject: Question about ggplot2 install
parts:
Hi:
I am an R and ggplot2 novice. I tried to install ggplot2 yesterday and
got the following warning message. Is this message going to be a
problem? If so, how do I take care of this? Thanks.
Satish


>> message follows
The downloaded packages are in
C:\Temp\RtmpDX8TsQ\downloaded_packages
updating HTML package descriptions
Warning message:
dependencies ‘Rgraphviz’, ‘marray’, ‘affy’, ‘Biobase’ are not
available

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Question about ggplot2 install
parts:
Don't worry about it. These are some bioconductor packages that
ggplot2 suggests you have, but does not required. If you do
install.packages("ggplot2") it shouldn't try and get them.

Hadley
